verifies.G006-C1: In one Designer session an attribute's column mapping and then an existing named query are changed in place, each through its own version-checked prepare and apply, and both changes are present in the final source model. Entity attributes, existing indexes and unique constraints, and existing named queries of the open entity (Java and Kotlin) are edited in place through the Designer's reviewed prepare and apply messages.
